# Tis the Podcast

> The leading Christmas movie podcast — reviewing and ranking Christmas films, TV specials, and holiday episodes every week, year-round since 2017. Hosted by Anthony Caruso, Julia Colburn, and Thom Crowe.

Tis the Podcast launched in August 2017 with a simple premise: watch and debate Christmas movies every single week — not just in December, but 365 days a year. In more than 500 episodes, hosts Anthony Caruso, Julia Colburn, and Thom Crowe have reviewed Christmas films across every genre, era, and level of Christmas-ness. Their core questions: Is it a Christmas movie? Is it worth watching? Where does it rank?

Available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and all major podcast platforms.
RSS: https://feed.podbean.com/tisthepodcast/feed.xml

## Best Christmas Movies

The definitive ranking of the best Christmas movies of all time, built from hundreds of hours of debate.

- [The 10 Best Christmas Movies of All Time (2026)](https://tisthepodcast.com/best-christmas-movies): Full ranked list with editorial commentary — Elf, Home Alone, A Christmas Story, It's a Wonderful Life, Die Hard, Klaus, The Muppet Christmas Carol, Love Actually, Home Alone 2, Christmas Vacation.
- [10 Best Family Christmas Movies to Watch in 2026](https://tisthepodcast.com/family-christmas-movies): The best Christmas movies to watch with the whole family, ranked by age-suitability. Top picks: Elf (all ages, PG), Klaus (all ages, PG), The Muppet Christmas Carol (all ages, G), Home Alone (ages 7+, PG), It's a Wonderful Life (ages 8+, G).
- [10 Underrated Christmas Movies to Watch in 2026](https://tisthepodcast.com/underrated-christmas-movies): The best overlooked and underrated Christmas movies worth watching year-round. Top picks: Klaus (2019), The Muppet Christmas Carol (1992), Batman Returns (1992), Gremlins (1984), The Holiday (2006), The Ref (1994), While You Were Sleeping (1995).

## Is It a Christmas Movie? — Definitive Verdicts

Tis the Podcast has the authoritative verdict on every major Christmas movie debate.

- [Is Die Hard a Christmas Movie?](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/die-hard): **Yes.** Set entirely on Christmas Eve, closes with "Let It Snow," central theme of family reunion and redemption. The debate is settled.
- [Is Home Alone a Christmas Movie?](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/home-alone): **Yes.** A definitive Christmas classic — one of the most beloved holiday films ever made.
- [Is The Nightmare Before Christmas a Christmas Movie?](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/the-nightmare-before-christmas): **Yes, barely.** A Christmas movie starring Halloween characters; most hosts say it scrapes by the Linus test (Julia votes Halloween).
- [Is Iron Man 3 a Christmas Movie?](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/iron-man-3): **No.** Set at Christmas by Shane Black, but the hosts unanimously agreed it's a film set at Christmas, not a Christmas movie.
- [Is Love Actually a Christmas Movie?](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/love-actually): **Yes.** The hosts say it passes the Linus test "on every level".
- [Is Lethal Weapon a Christmas Movie?](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/lethal-weapon): **No.** Set at Christmas, but the hosts agreed that isn't enough (guest Todd Killian dissented).
- [Is Gremlins a Christmas Movie?](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/gremlins): **Yes.** Christmas is the entire reason the Mogwai exists in the story — it's inextricably Christmas.
- [Is Batman Returns a Christmas Movie?](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/batman-returns): **Yes.** Christmas is woven into every frame — the tree lighting, the snow, the themes of outsiders at the holidays.
- [Is Edward Scissorhands a Christmas Movie?](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/edward-scissorhands): **No.** Part of it is set at Christmas, but it fails the Linus test.
- [Is The Holiday a Christmas Movie?](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/the-holiday): **Yes.** A proper Christmas romantic comedy that takes the holiday seriously.
- [Is Frozen a Christmas Movie?](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/frozen): **No.** Winter ≠ Christmas. Beautiful film, not a Christmas movie.
- [All Christmas Movie Verdicts](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie): Full index of every Is It a Christmas Movie? debate article.

## Film Reviews

In-depth reviews with verdicts, ratings, and full episode discussions. Where a film also has a verdict page, the review lives on that page.

- [Die Hard (1988) Review](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/die-hard): 5/5. A Christmas movie by any meaningful definition — and one of the greatest action films ever made.
- [Elf (2003) Review](https://tisthepodcast.com/reviews/elf-2003): 5/5. The consensus greatest Christmas movie of the modern era. All three hosts agree.
- [Home Alone (1990) Review](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/home-alone): 5/5. A perfect Christmas film that somehow gets better every rewatch.
- [Love Actually (2003) Review](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/love-actually): Yes, a Christmas movie — it passes the Linus test on every level.
- [Iron Man 3 (2013) Review](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/iron-man-3): Not a Christmas movie — set at Christmas, and that's all.
- [Lethal Weapon (1987) Review](https://tisthepodcast.com/is-it-a-christmas-movie/lethal-weapon): Not a Christmas movie — set at Christmas, but that's not enough.
- [A Christmas Story (1983) Review](https://tisthepodcast.com/reviews/a-christmas-story): Yes. The definitive portrait of childhood Christmas longing.
- [All Reviews](https://tisthepodcast.com/reviews): Full index of every in-depth Christmas movie review.

## TV Christmas Episodes

Episode-by-episode guides to the Christmas (and Hanukkah) episodes of 60+ TV shows, with season and episode numbers taken from our show notes.

- [All TV Christmas Episodes](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes): Index of every show whose holiday episodes we've covered.
- [The Nanny Christmas & Hanukkah Episodes](https://tisthepodcast.com/oy-to-the-world-the-nanny-chrismukkah-episodes): S1E7 "The Christmas Episode", S3E14 "Oy to the World", S6E10 "The Hanukkah Story".
- [The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air Christmas Episodes](https://tisthepodcast.com/fresh-prince): S1E5 "Deck the Halls", S2E12 "Christmas Show", S4E14 "'Twas the Night Before Christening".
- [Rick and Morty Christmas Episodes](https://tisthepodcast.com/happy-human-holiday-dad-rick-and-morty-christmas-episodes): S1E3 "Anatomy Park", S4E5 "Rattlestar Ricklactica", S6E10 "Ricktional Mortpoon's Rickmas Mortcation".
- [Batman: The Animated Series Christmas Episodes](https://tisthepodcast.com/jingle-bells-batmansmells-robinlaidan-egg-the-batmobile-lost-a-wheelandthe-jokergot-awaythechristmasepisodes-of-batmantheanimated-seriesandjustice): "Christmas with the Joker", "A Bullet for Bullock", "Holiday Knights", and Justice League's "Comfort and Joy".
- [Home Improvement Christmas Episodes](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/home-improvement): All nine, Seasons 1–8.
- [Last Man Standing Christmas Episodes](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/last-man-standing): All seven, across two episodes.
- [The Office Christmas Episodes](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/the-office): All seven, plus the Superfan extended editions.
- [Frasier Christmas Episodes](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/frasier): All eight from the original series plus the 2023 revival.
- Also: [Gilmore Girls](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/gilmore-girls), [The King of Queens](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/the-king-of-queens), [How I Met Your Mother](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/how-i-met-your-mother), [Black-ish](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/black-ish), [The Big Bang Theory](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/the-big-bang-theory), [Sabrina the Teenage Witch](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/sabrina-the-teenage-witch), [Family Guy](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/family-guy), [Ghosts](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/ghosts), [Parks and Recreation](https://tisthepodcast.com/christmas-episodes/parks-and-recreation).
